tool.name: Atlas
tool.command:
[ -f '$__tool_directory__/blobs.txt' ] && echo "Blobsref file exists" || (echo "Run Blobsref" && blobsref -o '$__tool_directory__/blobs.txt');
atlas \ -i '$input_image' \ -o 'output_image.tif' -rad '$gaussian_std' \ -pval '$p_value' \ -arealim '$area_lim' \ -ref '$__tool_directory__/blobs.txt' \ #if $verbose -v true #else -v false #end if \

param.name: input_image
param.label: The input image path
param.help: The width and height of the image should be even for best results.

param.name: gaussian_std
param.label: Standard deviation of the Gaussian window

param.name: p_value
param.label: P-value
param.help: P-value to account for the probability of false detection.

param.name: area_lim
param.label: Area limit
param.help: Remove detections smaller than this area.

tool.help:
**Adaptive spot detection with optimal scale selection (ATLAS).**
Basset, Boulanger, Salamero, Bouthemy, and Kervrann. Adaptive spot detection with optimal scale selection. IEEE Trans. Image Processing, 2015.
